departments.name: Store Operations
departments.description: Runs the retail stores and their inventory.

departments.name: Platform Engineering
departments.description: Builds and operates the WorkspaceNow installation.

departments.name: Events
departments.description: Runs in-store events, launches and tastings.

roles.name: Application Developer
roles.description: Builds applications, APIs, agents and workflows.

roles.name: Auditor
roles.description: Reads audit history and business records.

environments.name: Staging
environments.description: Release candidates verified against copies of production integrations.

environments.name: Production
environments.description: Live store operations. Promotion needs a Release Manager.

applications.name: Inventory Management
applications.description: Product catalogue and per-store stock levels. Publishes low-stock events.

applications.name: Procurement Management
applications.description: Purchase requests, approvals and purchase orders.

applications.name: Supplier Management
applications.description: The authoritative supplier register shared across the organization.

applications.name: Event Ticketing
applications.description: Issue tickets for store events and check guests in at the door by scanning their QR code.

entities.name: Supplier
entities.label: Supplier
entities.description: A company Northwind buys products from. Owned by Supplier Management and shared organization-wide.

entities.name: Stock
entities.label: Stock
entities.description: How many units of a Product one store holds, and when to reorder.

entities.name: PurchaseRequest
entities.label: Purchase request
entities.description: A request to buy stock, which needs approval before it becomes an order.

entities.name: PurchaseOrder
entities.label: Purchase order
entities.description: A commitment to buy from a Supplier, issued from an approved Purchase request.

entities.name: Sale
entities.label: Sale
entities.description: A sale rung up at an in-store till in Inventory Management. Created only by inventory.checkout, which also reduces stock.

entities.name: PosSale
entities.label: POS sale
entities.description: A till transaction read from the point-of-sale database. Owned by the external POS system; read-only here.

entities.name: Event
entities.label: Event
entities.description: An in-store event guests need a ticket for.

entities.name: Ticket
entities.label: Ticket
entities.description: One guest's admission to an event. Its QR code holds the ticket id.

mcp.description: Stock at or below its reorder level, with preferred supplier and any open purchase request.
Sell a cart at one store and return the receipt.
Active suppliers with category, rating and lead time.
Purchase requests, optionally filtered by status.
Submit a purchase request for approval.
Issue an order for an approved request.

tools.name: estimate_delivery
tools.description: Estimate delivery days for a route.

agents.name: Sidekick
agents.description: Everyday assistant in the console. Acts as the signed-in user, never beyond their own permissions.
agents.instructions: You help Northwind staff get work done from anywhere in the console. Answer questions and carry out requests with the tools you have. You act as the user: if they are not allowed to do something, say so and point them to who can.

agents.name: Procurement Assistant
agents.description: Prepares replenishment purchase requests from low-stock signals.
agents.instructions: You help Northwind's procurement team keep stores stocked. Read low-stock items and suppliers, follow procurement policy, and submit purchase requests. Never approve requests or issue orders; humans approve.

agents.name: Inventory Insights
agents.description: Answers questions about stock levels for store managers.
agents.instructions: Answer stock questions using inventory tools only. You cannot change stock.

agents.name: Application Architect
agents.instructions: Built-in platform agent. Converts requirements into application plans. Proposes changes to the Application Blueprint for a human to approve.

agents.name: Data Agent
agents.instructions: Built-in platform agent. Creates entities and relationships. Proposes changes to the Application Blueprint for a human to approve.

agents.name: UI Agent
agents.instructions: Built-in platform agent. Generates pages and forms. Proposes changes to the Application Blueprint for a human to approve.

agents.name: API Agent
agents.instructions: Built-in platform agent. Creates API operations. Proposes changes to the Application Blueprint for a human to approve.

agents.name: Workflow Agent
agents.instructions: Built-in platform agent. Designs business processes. Proposes changes to the Application Blueprint for a human to approve.

agents.name: Integration Agent
agents.instructions: Built-in platform agent. Configures integrations. Proposes changes to the Application Blueprint for a human to approve.

agents.name: Security Agent
agents.instructions: Built-in platform agent. Reviews security and permissions. Proposes changes to the Application Blueprint for a human to approve.

agents.name: Testing Agent
agents.instructions: Built-in platform agent. Generates and executes tests. Proposes changes to the Application Blueprint for a human to approve.

workflows.name: Low-stock replenishment
workflows.description: When stock falls to its reorder level, the Procurement Assistant prepares a purchase request, a Procurement Manager approves it, and a purchase order is issued.

steps.name: Prepare purchase request
steps.prompt: Prepare a purchase request to replenish {{productName}} at {{store}} (stock {{quantity}}, reorder level {{reorderLevel}}).

steps.name: Procurement Manager approval
steps.description: A Procurement Manager reviews the request.

steps.name: Notify store
steps.message: Purchase order {{orderNumber}} issued to replenish {{productName}} at {{store}}.

workflows.name: Send order to supplier
workflows.description: Sends every issued purchase order to the supplier over EDI.

workflows.name: Weekly supplier review
workflows.description: Every Monday the Procurement Assistant summarises supplier performance for the sourcing team.

workflows.name: Store stock count reminder
workflows.description: Manually started reminder for stores to run a cycle count.

steps.name: Remind store managers
steps.message: Please complete this week's cycle count.
